order_items_cost_snapshot_complete.name: order_items_cost_snapshot_complete
order_items_cost_snapshot_complete.value:
("order_items"."unit_cost_paise" is null and "order_items"."line_cost_paise" is null)
        or ("order_items"."unit_cost_paise" is not null and "order_items"."line_cost_paise" is not null)

order_items_hsn_sac_code_present.name: order_items_hsn_sac_code_present
order_items_hsn_sac_code_present.value: "order_items"."hsn_sac_code" is null or nullif(btrim("order_items"."hsn_sac_code"), '') is not null

orders_tax_metadata_valid.name: orders_tax_metadata_valid
orders_tax_metadata_valid.value:
"orders"."tax_calculation_policy_version" > 0
        and "orders"."tax_is_demo" = true
        and "orders"."tax_disclaimer" = 'Portfolio demo — not a statutory tax invoice'
        and nullif(btrim("orders"."place_of_supply_state"), '') is not null

orders_delivery_tax_snapshot_valid.name: orders_delivery_tax_snapshot_valid
orders_delivery_tax_snapshot_valid.value:
"orders"."delivery_tax_rule_version" > 0
        and "orders"."delivery_tax_rate_bps" between 0 and 10000
        and "orders"."delivery_taxable_amount_paise" >= 0
        and "orders"."delivery_tax_paise" >= 0
        and "orders"."delivery_taxable_amount_paise"::bigint + "orders"."delivery_tax_paise"::bigint = "orders"."delivery_fee_paise"::bigint
        and nullif(btrim("orders"."delivery_hsn_sac_code"), '') is not null

disclaimer.name: disclaimer
disclaimer.default: 'Portfolio demo — not a statutory tax invoice'

tax_rules_disclaimer_exact.name: tax_rules_disclaimer_exact
tax_rules_disclaimer_exact.value: "tax_rules"."disclaimer" = 'Portfolio demo — not a statutory tax invoice'
